review.summary: B1-B30 are correctly implemented. The save failure path violates B31 by swallowing the error and always returning ok true.

findings.problem: For a store whose write(value) throws, save catches the exception, discards its message, and returns {ok:true}. For example, save({write(){throw new Error("disk full")}},42) returns ok true instead of ok false with the error message and preserved input value.
findings.nextAction: Return ok:false with the thrown error message and preserve the input value in the failure result.
